a bridge extended over the midst of Hell,

sharper than a sword, and thinner than a hair, over which the creatures will pass, the people of Paradise passing over it with their works, some like the blinding lightning, and some like the wind sent forth, and some like coursers, and some running, and some walking, and some dragging themselves along; and a crier will cry, from the lower parts of the empyrean,
Lower your eyes until Fátimeh, the daughter of Mohammad,
may God bless and save him, and may God be well pleased with her and her two sons,
and the fire will say to the believer,
Pass thou over, O believer, for thy light hath extinguished my flame;
and thereupon, the feet of the people of the fire will slip.

maqayis: الصاد والراء والطاء وهو من باب الإبدال، وقد ذكر في السين، وهو الطريق. قال: أكر على الحروريين مهري ... وأحملهم على وضح الصراط
mufradat: الصراط: الطريق المستقيم. قال تعالى: وأن هذا صراطي مستقيما [الأنعام/ 153] ، ويقال له: سراط، وقد تقدم.
